Our approach

ATTACK. DEFENCE. SECURE.

Understand exposure through authorized assessment. Turn evidence into defensive decisions. Verify the outcome and improve the next review.

Authorization is the starting condition. The methodology describes scoped professional work; it does not authorize testing. Active assessment requires explicit permission, exclusions, and rules of engagement.

01Connected methodology

A working loop, not an isolated test.

Assessment and defense methodology

Attack · authorized assessmentDefence · owned decisionsSecure · verify & improve

ATTACK / AUTHORIZED ASSESSMENT

Agree the environment before reviewing it.

Start with the organization’s objectives, system ownership, and available inventory. Resolve unclear boundaries and record exclusions before discovery informs assessment.

The review question

Who can authorize access, and which systems are explicitly excluded?

Input

Business objectives, asset owners, and known inventory

Working output → next stage

An agreed scope, ownership map, and evidence gaps

Before an engagement

Agree how the work will be judged.

Useful assessment work connects technical findings to an agreed operational outcome.

  1. Scope & authority

    Approved systems, asset owners, exclusions, test windows, and emergency stop contacts.

  2. Evidence & decisions

    Collection boundaries, review ownership, impact context, and documented limitations.

  3. Remediation & verification

    Achievable actions, responsible owners, change approval, and retest criteria.
